input.github:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, dev]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # CI executes code from pull requests; do not leave a readable
          # GITHUB_TOKEN credential in the checkout for build scripts.
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
      - run: npm install --global npm@10.9.3
      - run: node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm audit --audit-level=high
      - run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
      - run: npm run check:docs
      - run: npm run check:ci-parity
      - run: npm run check:runbooks
      - run: npm run check:versions
      - run: npm run check:format
      - run: npm run check:architecture
      - run: npm run check:verification
      - run: npm run check:promotion-policy
      - run: git diff --check
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run test:unit
      - run: npm run test:release-tools
      - run: npm run check:licenses
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run
      - run: npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run --env development
      - run: npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run --env production
      - run: node scripts/check-release-contract.mjs
      - run: npm run pack:smoke
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - run: npm run test:package:e2e

  native-runner:
    name: Runner native checks (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
      - run: npm install --global npm@10.9.3
      - run: node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run test --workspace=@aloneio/runmesh-runner
      - run: npm run pack:smoke
      - run: node scripts/check-installer-syntax.mjs
      - run: node --test test/installer-arguments.test.mjs test/installer-preflight.test.mjs
      - run: node --test test/worker-validation.test.mjs
      - run: npm run test:domain
      - run: npm run test:contracts
      - run: node --test test/verification-tools.test.mjs test/package-verification.test.mjs
      - run: node --test test/architecture.test.mjs

  runner-lts:
    name: Runner LTS (${{ matrix.node }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        node: [22.23.2, 24.21.0]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
      - run: npm install --global npm@10.9.3
      - run: node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm run pack:smoke
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}
      - run: npm install --global npm@10.9.3
      - run: npm run test --workspace=@aloneio/runmesh-runner
      - run: node apps/runner/dist/runmesh.cjs --version

  verify-all:
    if: always()
    needs: [verify, native-runner, runner-lts]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every platform and supported runtime
        env:
          VERIFY: ${{ needs.verify.result }}
          NATIVE: ${{ needs.native-runner.result }}
          LTS: ${{ needs.runner-lts.result }}
        run: test "$VERIFY" = success && test "$NATIVE" = success && test "$LTS" = success
input.gitlab:
stages:
  - verify

workflow:
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" || $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "dev")'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web"'
    - when: never

image: node:22.23.2-bookworm@sha256:8a34c4ab3ea2c5cd194f07e317b2a8f09461d3c8b05c4e34c8ccd56d56024c4d

variables:
  npm_config_cache: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.npm"

cache:
  key:
    files:
      - package-lock.json
  paths:
    - .npm/

verify:
  stage: verify
  script:
    - npm install --global npm@10.9.3
    - node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs
    - npm ci
    - npm audit --audit-level=high
    - npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
    - npm run check:docs
    - npm run check:ci-parity
    - npm run check:runbooks
    - npm run check:versions
    - npm run check:format
    - npm run check:architecture
    - npm run check:verification
    - npm run check:promotion-policy
    - git diff --check
    - npm run typecheck
    - npm run test:unit
    - npm run test:release-tools
    - npm run check:licenses
    - npm run build
    - npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run
    - npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run --env development
    - npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run --env production
    - node scripts/check-release-contract.mjs
    - npm run pack:smoke
    - npm run test:e2e
    - npm run test:package:e2e
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" || $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "dev")'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web"'
    - when: never

# BEGIN GENERATED MAIN SOURCE POLICY
main-source-policy:
  stage: .pre
  image: node:22.23.2-bookworm@sha256:8a34c4ab3ea2c5cd194f07e317b2a8f09461d3c8b05c4e34c8ccd56d56024c4d
  inherit:
    default: false
    variables: false
  variables:
    GIT_STRATEGY: none
  cache: []
  dependencies: []
  needs: []
  before_script: []
  after_script: []
  services: []
  tags: []
  allow_failure: false
  interruptible: false
  timeout: 2m
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
      when: on_success
    - when: never
  script:
    - |
      node <<'RUNMESH_POLICY'
      function gitlabMainPromotion(environment) {
        const reject = () => { throw new Error("main accepts only a same-project dev merge request with current MR metadata"); };
        if (environment.CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE !== "merge_request_event"
          || !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/u.test(environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID ?? "")
          || typeof environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME !== "string"
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME.length === 0) reject();
        if (environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME !== "main") {
          return { policy: "main-from-dev-v1", applies: false };
        }
        const id = environment.CI_PROJECT_ID;
        if (!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/u.test(id ?? "")
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_PROJECT_ID !== id
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_PROJECT_ID !== id
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME !== "dev") reject();
        return { policy: "main-from-dev-v1", allowed: true };
      }
      try { console.log(JSON.stringify(gitlabMainPromotion(process.env))); }
      catch {
        console.error("main_source_policy_denied: use a same-project dev -> main merge request");
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
      RUNMESH_POLICY

pkg.name: @aloneio/runmesh-monorepo
pkg.description: A language-neutral protocol foundation for remotely managed agent runtimes.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:domain && npm run test:contracts && npm run test --workspaces && node --test ./test/admin-navigation.test.mjs ./test/ui-catalog.test.mjs

groups.description: Wire schemas and deterministic shared contracts
Public pure rules in Node; no DO, disk or subprocess adapters
Documentation examples against actual schemas; not handler execution
Local Runner unit, filesystem, process and adapter integration; not all pure
Local workerd/Miniflare unit and integration; not deployed Cloudflare
Node build, release and gate tests; not a signed publication
Generated UI and language source checks
Real local Worker-Runner MCP integration; run twice for source and installed package

input.ignore:
node_modules/
dist/
coverage/
.wrangler/
*.tsbuildinfo
.env
.env.*
.dev.vars
.dev.vars.*
release/assets/
release/download/
.DS_Store

# Local project audit reports
/docs/runmesh-project-audit-*.md
/.audit/

# Local verification evidence and CI package cache are never source.
/.verification/
/.npm/
input.release:
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: "Reviewed stable version; must match root package.json"
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  # Publishing the annotated tag and prerelease requires repository contents
  # write access. All other permissions remain unset by default.
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: runmesh-release-${{ inputs.version }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  source:
    name: main-only release source
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Reject a non-main release before verification and signing
        run: test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main"
  verification:
    needs: [source]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml

  release:
    name: signed stable release from verified main
    needs: [verification]
    if: github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner
    permissions:
      contents: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    environment:
      name: release
    env:
      RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
      RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out triggering commit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: npm
      - run: npm install --global npm@10.9.3
      - run: node scripts/check-toolchain.mjs
      - name: Validate triggering commit, release identity, and secrets
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main"
          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "aloneio/runmesh"
          test "$GITHUB_ACTOR" = "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          test "$GITHUB_TRIGGERING_ACTOR" = "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          git fetch --no-tags origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/main
          # A stable release is always for the current protected main tip. Do
          # not allow a manually dispatched run to publish an older ancestor
          # after newer code has landed on the branch.
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          npm run generate:version
          # The generated version module is committed release input, not a
          # workflow-local mutation. Refuse to publish if the triggering commit
          # left it stale; otherwise this step could silently release bytes that
          # are not represented by GITHUB_SHA.
          git diff --exit-code -- apps/worker/src/generated-version.ts apps/worker/src/generated-release.ts
          npm run check:versions
          ROOT_VERSION="$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')"
          test "$RELEASE_VERSION" = "$ROOT_VERSION"
          # This workflow and the hosted installer are the fixed
          # v0.1.3 stable patch contract. Refuse a future version until its
          # installer constants, key, and independent review are rotated.
          test "$RELEASE_VERSION" = "0.1.3"
          test -n "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID"
          # The hosted installer embeds this reviewed key ID for the fixed
          # v0.1.3 contract; a different valid key would make the
          # published asset unverifiable by the installer.
          test "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID" = "runmesh-preview-2026-01"
          test "$(node -p 'require("./apps/runner/package.json").version')" = "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          test "$(node -p 'require("./apps/worker/package.json").version')" = "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          test "$(node -p 'require("./packages/protocol/package.json").version')" = "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          node scripts/release-signature.mjs validate-key release/trust-keyring.json "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID"
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm audit --audit-level=high
      - run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
      - run: npm run check:docs
      - run: npm run check:versions
      - run: npm run check:format
      - run: git diff --check
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run test:unit
      - run: npm run test:e2e
      - run: npm run test:release-tools
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Refuse build-generated tracked mutations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The manifest commit must describe every source byte used to build
          # the package. Generated output belongs in ignored dist paths; any
          # tracked mutation means the checkout was stale or the build is not
          # reproducible from GITHUB_SHA.
          git diff --exit-code
      - run: npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run
      - run: npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run --env development
      - run: npm run validate:worker -- --dry-run --env production
      - run: node scripts/check-release-contract.mjs
      - run: npm run check:licenses
      - run: npm run pack:smoke
      - name: Build immutable portable Runner artifact
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf release/assets
          mkdir -p release/assets
          npm pack --workspace=@aloneio/runmesh-runner --pack-destination release/assets
          packed="$(find release/assets -maxdepth 1 -name '*.tgz' -print -quit)"
          test -n "$packed"
          # Check the exact bytes that will be signed and uploaded. The
          # pack:smoke gate exercises a separate pack, so keep this final
          # artifact check here as the authoritative hosted-installer bound.
          node -e '
            const { statSync } = require("node:fs");
            const path = process.argv[1];
            const size = statSync(path).size;
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(size) || size <= 0 || size > 8 * 1024 * 1024) {
              throw new Error(`release Runner artifact size is outside the 8 MiB bound: ${size}`);
            }
            console.log(`release Runner artifact size: ${size} bytes`);
          ' "$packed"
          # npm prepack also regenerates the protocol schema; do not let a
          # tracked generated-file drift enter an artifact whose manifest
          # still claims the triggering commit.
          git diff --exit-code
          mv "$packed" "release/assets/runmesh-runner-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tgz"
      - name: Exercise the exact portable archive end to end before signing
        run: node scripts/test-packed-runner.mjs "release/assets/runmesh-runner-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tgz"
      - name: Generate deterministic manifest and checksums
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          published_at="$(date --utc --date="@$(git log -1 --format=%ct)" +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          node scripts/release-manifest.mjs release/assets "$RELEASE_VERSION" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$published_at"
      - name: Sign and verify manifest and local release assets
        env:
          RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY"
          node scripts/release-signature.mjs sign release/assets/manifest.json release/assets/manifest.sig release/assets/manifest.signature.json release/trust-keyring.json "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID"
          node scripts/release-signature.mjs verify release/assets/manifest.json release/assets/manifest.sig release/assets/manifest.signature.json release/trust-keyring.json "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID"
          cp release/trust-keyring.json LICENSE NOTICE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md release/assets/
          (cd release/assets && sha256sum *.tgz manifest.json manifest.sig manifest.signature.json LICENSE NOTICE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md trust-keyring.json > SHA256SUMS)
          # Verify the exact bytes that will be uploaded before creating the
          # immutable tag/release. The post-publication check remains as an
          # independent transport/infrastructure verification.
          node scripts/release-verify.mjs release/assets/manifest.json release/assets/manifest.sig release/assets/manifest.signature.json release/trust-keyring.json "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID" "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          (cd release/assets && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
      - name: Preserve signed release assets as an unpublished CI artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: runmesh-signed-release-${{ env.RELEASE_VERSION }}
          path: release/assets
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Verify tag and release do not already exist
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$GH_TOKEN"
          # Re-check the protected branch tip immediately before publishing;
          # long-running test/build gates may otherwise release an older SHA
          # after new code lands on main.
          git fetch --no-tags origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          tag="v${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          # A local tag check alone is racy and can miss tags that were created
          # after checkout. Probe the remote API explicitly and treat only a
          # genuine 404 as "does not exist"; auth, rate-limit, and transport
          # failures must stop the release instead of being interpreted as an
          # absent release.
          api_status() {
            local url="$1" status
            if ! status="$(curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}" \
              "$url")"; then
              echo "GitHub API request failed: $url" >&2
              return 1
            fi
            case "$status" in
              2??|404) printf '%s\n' "$status" ;;
              *) echo "GitHub API request returned HTTP $status: $url" >&2; return 1 ;;
            esac
          }
          encoded_tag="$(node -p 'encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1])' "$tag")"
          tag_status="$(api_status "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${encoded_tag}")"
          if [ "$tag_status" != 404 ]; then
            echo "Remote tag already exists: $tag" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          release_status="$(api_status "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${encoded_tag}")"
          if [ "$release_status" != 404 ]; then
            echo "GitHub Release already exists for tag: $tag" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Require the audited production control plane before creating a release tag
        run: node scripts/check-live-release-prereqs.mjs https://runmesh.aloneio.workers.dev
      - name: Create annotated release tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="v${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          # gh release create creates a lightweight tag when the tag is absent.
          # Preserve the established release contract by creating the annotated
          # Git tag object and ref explicitly, while keeping checkout credentials
          # disabled. This tag is annotated (the manifest remains the signed
          # artifact trust root); no Git signing key is available in CI.
          tag_object_sha="$(gh api --method POST \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags" \
            --field "tag=${tag}" \
            --field "message=Runmesh ${tag} stable release" \
            --field "object=${GITHUB_SHA}" \
            --field 'type=commit' \
            --jq '.sha')"
          test "$tag_object_sha" = "${tag_object_sha,,}" \
            && [[ "$tag_object_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          ref_object_sha="$(gh api --method POST \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs" \
            --field "ref=refs/tags/${tag}" \
            --field "sha=${tag_object_sha}" \
            --jq '.object.sha')"
          test "$ref_object_sha" = "$tag_object_sha"
          target_sha="$(gh api \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${tag_object_sha}" \
            --jq '.object.sha')"
          target_type="$(gh api \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${tag_object_sha}" \
            --jq '.object.type')"
          test "$target_sha" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$target_type" = commit
      - name: Create stable draft release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh release create "v${RELEASE_VERSION}" release/assets/* \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target main \
            --verify-tag \
            --draft \
            --title "Runmesh v${RELEASE_VERSION}" \
            --prerelease=false \
            --notes-file docs/release-notes.md
      - name: Verify draft release assets before publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="v${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          draft_dir="release/draft-download"
          rm -rf "$draft_dir"
          mkdir -p "$draft_dir"
          draft_json="release/draft-release.json"
          gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft,isPrerelease,tagName,assets > "$draft_json"
          DRAFT_JSON="$draft_json" RELEASE_VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION" node --input-type=module -e '
            import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
            const release = JSON.parse(await readFile(process.env.DRAFT_JSON, "utf8"));
            const expectedTag = `v${process.env.RELEASE_VERSION}`;
            if (release.tagName !== expectedTag || release.isDraft !== true || release.isPrerelease !== false) {
              throw new Error(`draft release metadata is invalid for ${expectedTag}`);
            }
            const expected = new Set([
              `runmesh-runner-${process.env.RELEASE_VERSION}.tgz`,
              "manifest.json",
              "manifest.sig",
              "manifest.signature.json",
              "SHA256SUMS",
              "LICENSE",
              "NOTICE",
              "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md",
              "trust-keyring.json",
            ]);
            const names = (release.assets ?? []).map((asset) => asset?.name);
            if (names.length !== expected.size || new Set(names).size !== names.length || names.some((name) => !expected.has(name))) {
              throw new Error(`draft release assets are incomplete or unexpected: ${names.join(",")}`);
            }
          '
          gh release download "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --dir "$draft_dir"
          for asset in \
            "runmesh-runner-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tgz" manifest.json manifest.sig manifest.signature.json \
            SHA256SUMS LICENSE NOTICE THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md trust-keyring.json; do
            test -f "$draft_dir/$asset"
          done
          test "$(find "$draft_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" -eq 9
          node scripts/release-verify.mjs "$draft_dir/manifest.json" "$draft_dir/manifest.sig" "$draft_dir/manifest.signature.json" release/trust-keyring.json "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID" "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          GITHUB_SHA="$GITHUB_SHA" node --input-type=module -e '
            import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
            const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(process.argv[1], "utf8"));
            if (manifest.commit_sha !== process.env.GITHUB_SHA) {
              throw new Error(`draft manifest commit ${manifest.commit_sha} does not match triggering commit ${process.env.GITHUB_SHA}`);
            }
          ' "$draft_dir/manifest.json"
          (cd "$draft_dir" && grep -vE '(^|[[:space:]])trust-keyring\.json$' SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -)
          cmp "$draft_dir/SHA256SUMS" release/assets/SHA256SUMS
          cmp "$draft_dir/trust-keyring.json" release/trust-keyring.json
          RELEASE_VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION" tar -xOf "$draft_dir/runmesh-runner-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tgz" package/package.json | RELEASE_VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION" node -e 'let x="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>x+=d).on("end",()=>{if(JSON.parse(x).version!==process.env.RELEASE_VERSION)process.exit(1)})'
      - name: Publish verified stable release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Re-check the protected main tip immediately before making the
          # draft public; a new commit may have landed while the draft was
          # being uploaded and independently verified.
          git fetch --no-tags origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          tag="v${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          # Re-check that the annotated tag still resolves to this exact
          # triggering commit after the draft was created.  --verify-tag only
          # checks that a tag exists; it does not bind the release to a target
          # commit if a privileged actor force-updates the ref in the meantime.
          encoded_tag="$(node -p 'encodeURIComponent(process.argv[1])' "$tag")"
          tag_object_type="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${encoded_tag}" --jq '.object.type')"
          tag_object_sha="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/tags/${encoded_tag}" --jq '.object.sha')"
          test "$tag_object_type" = tag
          test "$tag_object_sha" = "${tag_object_sha,,}" && [[ "$tag_object_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          target_sha="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${tag_object_sha}" --jq '.object.sha')"
          target_type="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${tag_object_sha}" --jq '.object.type')"
          test "$target_type" = commit
          test "$target_sha" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft)" = true
          gh release edit "$tag" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --verify-tag \
            --draft=false \
            --prerelease=false
          test "$(gh release view "$tag" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft,isPrerelease --jq '[.isDraft,.isPrerelease] | @tsv')" = $'false\tfalse'
          # Publishing a draft is the point at which GitHub applies repository
          # immutable-release protection. Fail the workflow if the repository
          # setting was disabled or the release was not locked as expected.
          release_id="$(gh api \
            --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/tags/${tag}" \
            --jq '.id')"
          test "$release_id" = "${release_id//[^0-9]/}" && test -n "$release_id"
          immutable="$(gh api \
            --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10' \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases/${release_id}" \
            --jq '.immutable')"
          test "$immutable" = true
      - name: Re-download and verify published assets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir release/download
          gh release download "v${RELEASE_VERSION}" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --dir release/download
          node scripts/release-verify.mjs release/download/manifest.json release/download/manifest.sig release/download/manifest.signature.json release/trust-keyring.json "$RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_ID" "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          GITHUB_SHA="$GITHUB_SHA" node --input-type=module -e '
            import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
            const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile("release/download/manifest.json", "utf8"));
            if (manifest.commit_sha !== process.env.GITHUB_SHA) {
              throw new Error(`published manifest commit ${manifest.commit_sha} does not match triggering commit ${process.env.GITHUB_SHA}`);
            }
          '
          # The downloaded keyring is checked byte-for-byte against the source
          # checkout below; do not treat its unsigned checksum as a trust root.
          (cd release/download && grep -vE '(^|[[:space:]])trust-keyring\.json$' SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -)
          cmp release/download/SHA256SUMS release/assets/SHA256SUMS
          cmp release/download/trust-keyring.json release/trust-keyring.json
          RELEASE_VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION" tar -xOf "release/download/runmesh-runner-${RELEASE_VERSION}.tgz" package/package.json | RELEASE_VERSION="$RELEASE_VERSION" node -e 'let x="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>x+=d).on("end",()=>{if(JSON.parse(x).version!==process.env.RELEASE_VERSION)process.exit(1)})'

promotion..gitlab/main-policy.yml:
# Generated by scripts/check-main-policy.mjs --write.
# Install as .gitlab/main-policy.yml@<project-path>:dev in project CI settings.
include:
  - project: '$CI_PROJECT_PATH'
    ref: '$CI_COMMIT_SHA'
    file: '/.gitlab-ci.yml'

# Do not let an old/source configuration omit the mandatory MR gate.
workflow:
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" || $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "dev")'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web"'
    - when: never

main-source-policy:
  stage: .pre
  image: node:22.23.2-bookworm@sha256:8a34c4ab3ea2c5cd194f07e317b2a8f09461d3c8b05c4e34c8ccd56d56024c4d
  inherit:
    default: false
    variables: false
  variables:
    GIT_STRATEGY: none
  cache: []
  dependencies: []
  needs: []
  before_script: []
  after_script: []
  services: []
  tags: []
  allow_failure: false
  interruptible: false
  timeout: 2m
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
      when: on_success
    - when: never
  script:
    - |
      node <<'RUNMESH_POLICY'
      function gitlabMainPromotion(environment) {
        const reject = () => { throw new Error("main accepts only a same-project dev merge request with current MR metadata"); };
        if (environment.CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE !== "merge_request_event"
          || !/^[1-9][0-9]*$/u.test(environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_IID ?? "")
          || typeof environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME !== "string"
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME.length === 0) reject();
        if (environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME !== "main") {
          return { policy: "main-from-dev-v1", applies: false };
        }
        const id = environment.CI_PROJECT_ID;
        if (!/^[1-9][0-9]*$/u.test(id ?? "")
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_PROJECT_ID !== id
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_PROJECT_ID !== id
          || environment.CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME !== "dev") reject();
        return { policy: "main-from-dev-v1", allowed: true };
      }
      try { console.log(JSON.stringify(gitlabMainPromotion(process.env))); }
      catch {
        console.error("main_source_policy_denied: use a same-project dev -> main merge request");
        process.exitCode = 1;
      }
      RUNMESH_POLICY
